description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Lockheed Martin is hiring a Software Engineer to develop, test, document, and debug software for business and mission problems. The role applies software development standards and tools across the development life cycle and resolves program errors and system capability questions.
Software Engineer Asc - E1 developing, testing, debugging, and documenting business/mission software across the development life cycle

Responsibilities:
• Plans, conducts, and coordinates software development activities
• Designs, develops, documents, tests, and debugs software that contains logical and mathematical solutions to business/mission problems or questions in computer language for solutions by means of data processing equipment
• Applies the appropriate standards, processes, procedures, and tools throughout the development life cycle
• Applies knowledge of computer hardware and software, subject matter to be programmed in business/mission applications, information processing techniques used, and information gathered from system users to develop software
• Corrects program errors, prepares operating instructions, compiles documentation of program development, and analyzes system capabilities to resolve questions of program intent, output requirements, input data acquisition, programming techniques, and controls
• Ensures software standards are met

Requirements:
• Experience with Java, Python, or other modern coding languages
• Familiarity with front-end technologies for example,  
HTML, CSS, React, and/or Streamlit
• Experience with databases and/or Continuous Integration/Continuous Delivery Pipelines (CI/CD)

Preferred:
• Bachelors degree in IT Information technology, Computer Science, Computer Engineering with an software development focus from an accredited college in a related discipline
• Familiarity with Atlassian tools (JIRA, Confluence, etc) and/or Gitlab
• Experience/certifications with Machine Learning and Natural Language Process technologies
• Demonstrated experience using key Python libraries and frameworks, such as NumPy, pandas, SciPy, Matplotlib/Seaborn, Flask/Django, Requests, SQLAlchemy, and pytest (or equivalent testing tools)
• Ability to select the appropriate library for data manipulation, scientific computing, web services, or automation tasks

• Demonstrated experience using key Python libraries and frameworks, such as NumPy, pandas, SciPy, Matplotlib/Seaborn, Flask/Django, Requests, SQLAlchemy, and pytest (or equivalent testing tools)
• Ability to select the appropriate library for data manipulation, scientific computing, web services, or automation tasks

Pay: $67K/yr - $124K/yr
